subject: [hw] V02 -> V19: your exact neon_route applied; 5 new routing cases; all green
body:
Applied your replacement verbatim in emu/n2a32_core.c. Cross-checked it against all 14 existing NEON rows and your examples:
  vshrn.i64 f2bf0812 -> neon_shift (was misc)
  vaddl.u32 f3e10002 -> neon_shift (was misc)
  vmla.i32 scalar f3e220e2 -> neon_shift (was misc)
  vshl.i64 f2bf05d2 -> neon_shift (was misc)
  vmov.i16 f2800812 -> neon_misc (was shift)
  vmovl.s16 f2900a11 -> neon_shift (unchanged, bits21-19 != 0)
and every existing sample keeps its class. I added those five encodings to test_v02 (llvm-mc generated) with the expected class. Suite now N2TEST V02 PASS 822/822 (ASan+UBSan 394, -O2 394, TSan 34).

Note for the record: T32-bit23=1 forms are converted EFxx->F2xx / FFxx->F3xx before this split, so the same rule applies. Please check your class against the five new rows in emu/test_v02/route_cases if you get a chance; if you later add a form whose bits4/21-19/7 differ from this rule, tell me and I will extend the table.
